body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> HTC(www.htc.com) introduced Android phone 'Droid Incredible' with Qualcomm's 'Snap Dragon' processor at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
'Droid Incredible' is smartphone which has been loaded Qualcomm's 'Snap Dragon' QSD8650 1Ghz processor and is supporting Android 2.1 OS. It features 3.7-inch display and 8 mega pixels camera.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
